help.title: DressApp: My DressApp Closet Book
help.subtitle: A Super Simple Guide to Managing Your Clothes & Outfits
help.geminiKeyStep: A Gemini API Key. Get it for free on Google AI Studio.
help.overview_p1: Welcome to DressApp! This is a cutting-edge app that lets you build your very own digital clothes closet.
help.overview_p2: Imagine taking pictures of all your shirts, pants, skirts, and shoes, and putting them into a magical book. Once they are inside, a professional and experienced stylist looks at your clothes, checks the weather outside, and helps you pick what to wear for any occasion!
help.overview_p3: You can also dress up your own character (avatar), trade or share clothes with friends, and see how much your closet is worth.
help.prereq_p1: To start working with DressApp, you will need:
help.prereq_item1: A computer, tablet, or phone with a web browser.
help.prereq_item2: A camera on your device to snap photos of your clothes.
help.prereq_item3: A microphone on your device so you can talk to your professional AI Stylist.
help.prereq_item4: A Gemini API Key. Get it for free on Google AI Studio (https://aistudio.google.com/).
help.add_clothes_p1: Let's put your physical clothes into your digital closet!
help.add_clothes_step1: Open DressApp and click the Add Item button.
help.add_clothes_step2: Click Take Photo to take a picture of your garment, click Upload Photos if you already have a picture saved, click Import URL to grab a garment from an online shop link, or click Upload Receipt to parse a PDF or image receipt from your purchases.
help.add_clothes_step3: The app checks if you already added this item before. If you did, a pop-up window will ask if you want to skip it.
help.add_clothes_step4: If it's a new item, wait 5 seconds. The app will magically remove the background, crop the clothing item, and extract its attributes.
help.add_clothes_step5: Check the results! You can choose the type of clothing (like shirt or pants). If the cutout shape looks wrong, changing the clothing type category will fix it.
help.add_clothes_step6: Click the Save button. Now the item is saved in your closet grid!
help.stylist_title: Talking to Your professional AI Stylist
help.stylist_p1: You have a professional AI stylist who gives you advice on what to wear. You can talk to it just like a friend!
help.stylist_step1: Go to the AI Stylist screen.
help.stylist_step3: Ask a question out loud, like: 'What matches my blue jeans for a rainy school day?'
help.stylist_step4: You will see your words appear on the screen as you talk.
help.stylist_step5: If the voice typing doesn't work, the app will record your voice and send it to the Stylist.
help.stylist_step6: The Stylist will read the weather, check what clothes are in your closet, and suggest an outfit.
help.stylist_step7: The Stylist will speak back to you! Click Play Reply to hear the advice again.
help.profile_p1: Your Profile page has different settings sections. Here is why each section is important:
help.profile_item1_desc: Upload a full-body photo for realistic try-ons or use the dynamic 2D vector mannequin (DynamicAvatar). Features local U2-Net background removal, interactive Skin Tone Picker, calibrated landmark alignment (collar top-[14.5%], waistband top-[36.5%]), and single-click photo removal.
help.profile_item2_desc: Set your aesthetics, color palette preferences, avoided items/colors, and modesty level (Casual, Moderate, Conservative). The AI Stylist uses these rules to generate outfit proposals you feel comfortable wearing.
help.profile_item3_desc: Manages your name, email, date of birth, phone number (required for push alerts), and delivery address with OpenStreetMap Nominatim street/city autocomplete.
help.profile_item4_desc: Eliminates sizing guesswork! On onboarding, enter just 4 basic numbers (Height, Weight, Waist, Foot Length) and the scikit-learn ANSUR II model automatically predicts your Shoulders, Chest, Hip, Sleeve, Inseam, and Outseam.
help.profile_item5_desc: Select sex, personal status, and occupation. Your occupation feeds the Trend Scout ranker to prioritize fashion news relevant to your daily lifestyle.
help.profile_item6_desc: Toggle default measurement scales for Weight (kg / lb) and Length (cm / in) across all sizing fields and recommendations.
help.profile_item7_desc: Register as a verified fashion professional (stylist, tailor, designer) with business contact info for inclusion in the /experts directory and regional campaign ticker.
help.profile_item8_desc: Set your receiver PayPal email to receive earnings from marketplace clothing sales and active expert promotion campaigns.
help.profile_item9_desc: Select Standard provider mode or input personal API keys (Google Gemini, Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek) via guided setup modal to route AI Stylist queries.
help.profile_item10_desc: View Free 50-item limit vs Manager ($4.99/mo) and Professional ($9.99/mo) tiers + Referral Code link (+10 extra capacity slots for every friend who registers up to 200 items max).
help.profile_item11_desc: Set daily morning outfit proposal notifications, frequency, notification time, style focus (Casual, Formal, Athletic, Custom), and browser VAPID push alerts.
help.profile_item12_desc: Configure granular switches for Local Fashion, Sale Alerts, Sustainable Fashion, Luxury Promos, and Personal Stylist + Max Reach distance slider (5km to 50km).
help.profile_item13_desc: Authenticates via Google OAuth to match daily outfits with your scheduled calendar events, meetings, dates, or travel agendas.
help.profile_item14_desc: Coordinates real-time weather forecasts with OpenWeatherMap and filters local Marketplace listings and experts near you.
help.profile_item15_desc: Select from 12 supported languages and customize the AI Stylist's regional TTS voice profile.
help.profile_item16_desc: Access Chrome Extension size comparison scripts, generate a Universal Bookmarklet, and share referral links for free closet expansions.
help.stats_p1: See how much your closet is worth and which items are your favorites!
help.stats_worth: Closet Worth: How much money all your clothes cost together.
help.stats_util: Closet Utilization: The percentage of clothes you have worn at least once.
help.stats_cpw: Cost-per-Wear: How cheap or expensive a garment is based on how many times you wore it.
help.stats_palette: Color Palette Breakdown: Stats showing your wardrobe's colors, materials, and categories breakdown.
help.planner_p1: The Outfit Planner helps you layer, arrange, and evaluate your styling selections:
help.planner_item1_desc: Layer and combine clothes dynamically on your custom character avatar to build your outfit layout.
help.planner_item2_desc: If you are wearing a jacket or outerwear over a shirt, the interface renders a side-by-side view (one avatar showing the outerwear, one without) so you can review both layers simultaneously.
help.planner_item3_desc: Click directly on any clothing item on your avatar's body to open its dedicated details pane.
help.planner_item4_desc: Displays progress bars grading how well your outfit matches current weather alerts, formality rules, and color guidelines.
help.suitcase_step1: Go to the Suitcase page and fill out your trip details (where you are going, when, and what you will do).
help.suitcase_step2: The Stylist will show you a daily packing checklist.
help.suitcase_step3: If the weather is going to rain, the Stylist will warn you if you forgot an umbrella or raincoat, and will suggest options.
help.suitcase_step4: You can type in the chat to tell the Stylist to change things (e.g. 'Pack a casual outfit for day 2').
help.suitcase_step5: Click Approve Suitcase to lock in your list!
help.market_p1: Share, donate, rent, or trade clothes with other users in your area!
help.market_step1: Create a Listing: Open an item's detail page, select Edit Intent, and choose For Sale, Rent, Swap, or Donate.
help.market_step2: Try-On Sandbox: Buyers can test-fit your listing against their own clothes on their avatar before deciding to swap or buy.
help.closet_page_p1: The Closet page lets you view, search, and manage your digitized garments:
help.closet_view_desc: Browse all your registered shirts, pants, skirts, shoes, and outerwear in a grid. Filter by color, category, season, or material.
help.closet_select_desc: Enable select mode to checkmark multiple clothing items and bulk delete them from your wardrobe database in a single action.
help.closet_group_desc: Combine individual garments into a synchronized Set (like a suit or matching dress sets) to ensure they are suggested together. You can ungroup sets back into single items anytime.
help.closet_edit_desc: Fine-tune parsed parameters. Manually edit season compatibility, formality tags, primary/secondary colors, fabrics, and custom annotations inside the item's detail editor.
help.trend_scout_p1: Keep your fashion style ahead of the curve with our daily curated feed:
help.trend_feed_desc: Receives style suggestions, fashion trends, and articles tailored specifically to match your profile preferences.
help.trend_buckets_desc: Explore four curated categories: SS26 Runway (latest high-fashion), News Flash (breaking style reports), Recycling (sustainable fashion), and Influencers (social trendsetters).
help.experts_p1: Connect with real-world fashion experts directly inside DressApp:
help.experts_dir_desc: Browse a registry of certified professional stylists, fashion advisors, and wardrobe consultants.
help.experts_search_desc: Filter experts by region, country, or specific fashion specialties.
help.experts_contact_desc: Reach out directly via phone, send direct emails, or visit their professional portfolios and websites.
help.expected_item1: Your clothes will appear in your digital closet as clean cutouts without backgrounds.
help.expected_item2: If your clothes were cut off in the photo, the AI will fill in the missing pieces (using Nano Banana reconstruction).
help.expected_item3: Scanned retail QR tags will show a green badge verifying materials.
help.expected_item4: Your avatar will display your layered clothes without any visual glitches.
help.trouble_full_q: Help! My closet is full and I can't add more clothes!
help.trouble_full_why: Why it happens: Free accounts are limited to a baseline of 50 items (up to 200 items with referral bonuses).
help.trouble_full_fix: Easy fix: 1. Subscribe to the Manager or Professional plan, or share your invite link with a friend to get +10 extra spots (up to 200 items max).
help.trouble_cam_why: Why it happens: Your web browser doesn't have permission to use the camera.
help.trouble_cam_fix: Easy fix: Go to browser settings, allow camera access, and refresh the page.
help.trouble_slow_q: The app is running slow when I upload multiple pictures!
help.trouble_slow_why: Why it happens: Processing pictures takes a lot of computer work.
help.trouble_slow_fix: Easy fix: The app automatically processes them one by one. Just wait a minute!
help.limit_item1: Voice typing works best on Google Chrome or Apple Safari browsers.
help.limit_item2: Dark, blurry, or folded clothes might not be recognized correctly by the scanner. Try taking pictures in a bright room with the garment laid flat.
help.shopping_assistant_p1: Find the perfect clothing fit when shopping online on Zara, ASOS, and other partner stores.
help.shopping_assistant_step1: Install the **DressApp Chrome Extension** from the Web Store.
help.shopping_assistant_step2: Navigate to any garment details page on a partner site.
help.shopping_assistant_step3: The assistant automatically reads the page size chart.
help.shopping_assistant_step4: It checks your **body measurements** stored in your Profile details.
help.shopping_assistant_step5: It recommends the best size for you, highlighting the fit comparison.
help.shopping_assistant_step6: Click **Add to Closet** to import the item draft straight to your app.
help.import_wardrobe_p1: Already have your wardrobe tracked in another app? Import your items into DressApp with just a few clicks. We support imports from a wide range of popular wardrobe and outfit planning apps.
help.import_wardrobe_step2: Scroll down the profile page and hit 'Wardrobe import'.
help.import_wardrobe_step3: Select the app you're importing from (e.g., Cladwell, Stylebook, Acloset, SmartCloset, or a CSV file).
help.import_wardrobe_step4: Follow the on-screen instructions to export your data from the old app and upload it to DressApp.
help.import_wardrobe_step5: DressApp will automatically categorize and organize your imported items.
help.import_wardrobe_step6: Review your items and adjust categories if needed. Your wardrobe is now ready!
help.scheduler_push_p1: Start your day with automatic, weather-appropriate style recommendations delivered directly to your device.
help.scheduler_push_step3: Toggle **Enable Morning Alerts** and select your preferred notification time.
help.scheduler_push_step4: Link your **Google Calendar** to let the scheduler check your daily event schedule.
help.scheduler_push_step5: The system tracks weather forecasts and generates 3 custom outfit configurations.
help.scheduler_push_step6: Tap the push alert to open the Match tab, where you can view suggestions on your avatar and select one to schedule it to the calendar.
help.campaigns_help_p1: Find exclusive sales, stylist events, and local fashion offers in your area:
help.campaigns_feed_help_desc: Browse a live list of promotional campaigns published by verified fashion experts near your city or region.
help.campaigns_maps_help_desc: Click any offer to view its description, copy discount codes, and locate the boutique, designer, or stylist directly on Google Maps.
help.campaigns_save_help_desc: Bookmark your favorite local deals to view later, or share them directly with friends.
help.expert_campaigns_help_p1: Track and update your business promotions from your Expert settings:
help.expert_campaigns_status_desc: Keep track of whether your campaign is a Draft, Pending approval, Active, Paused, or Rejected.
help.expert_campaigns_extend_desc: Keep a successful campaign running longer. Extensions are billed automatically and do not require admin review.
help.expert_campaigns_pause_desc: Temporarily hide your offer from the feed when you are busy. Any paused days are added back to your end date on resume.
help.expert_campaigns_delete_desc: Delete your campaign at any time. Active campaigns are removed immediately without refund.
help.create_campaign_help_p1: Create a local promotion using the simple step-by-step wizard:
help.create_campaign_button_desc: Click 'New Campaign' in your dashboard to open the 6-step creation wizard.
help.create_campaign_step_desc: Fill in basic details, promotion dates, location, reach radius, target demographics, and notification choices.
help.create_campaign_fee_desc: Billed at a simple flat rate of $1.00 USD per day. You must connect your PayPal email before submitting.
help.create_campaign_submit_desc: After PayPal payment, campaigns go to the admin moderation queue and are activated immediately upon approval.
help.tiers_p1: DressApp offers flexible subscription tiers tailored to your closet size and styling needs. Upgrade on the Pricing page to unlock unlimited features.
help.tiers_free_desc: Baseline limit of 50 items. Expandable up to 200 items by sharing your invite code with friends (+10 capacity slots per friend).
help.tiers_manager_desc: Costs $4.99/mo. Removes closet size limits entirely, unlocks advanced stats, calendar synchronization, and Trend Scout ranking filters.
help.tiers_pro_desc: Costs $9.99/mo. Built for style experts and fashion creators. Allows registration in the stylist directory and creation of fashion campaigns.
help.tiers_step1: Go to your Profile settings page.
help.tiers_step2: Scroll down to the System Preferences section.
help.tiers_step3: Locate Closet & Subscription Limits and click on the Pricing Page link.
help.tiers_step4: Select your preferred plan and complete checkout securely.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: DressApp privacy policy — how we collect, use, and protect your data.
privacy.intro: DressApp ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our application.
privacy.dataCollection: We collect information you provide directly, including your name, email address, phone number, profile photos, body measurements, style preferences, and payment information. We also collect data automatically, such as device information, usage analytics, and cookies.
privacy.dataUse: Your data is used to provide and improve our services, personalize your experience, process transactions, send relevant notifications, and ensure the security and integrity of our platform.
privacy.dataSharing: We do not sell your personal data. We may share limited information with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our platform, subject to strict confidentiality obligations.
privacy.aiUsage: Our AI-powered stylist and measurement prediction features process your body measurements and photos locally or on secure servers to generate personalized recommendations. No biometric data is shared with advertisers or third parties.
privacy.storage: Data is stored securely using encryption at rest and in transit. We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.
privacy.retention: We retain your data for as long as necessary to provide our services. You may request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time through your account settings or by contacting us.
privacy.rights: You have the right to access, correct, export, and delete your personal data. You may also opt out of data processing for marketing purposes at any time. To exercise these rights, please contact us through the app or at our privacy email.
privacy.cookies: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience, analyze usage, and personalize content. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.
privacy.contact: For any privacy-related inquiries, please reach out to us through the app settings or via the contact form on our website at dressapp.co.

extension.step1Desc: Install "DressApp Wardrobe Assistant" from the Chrome Web Store on your desktop browser.
extension.step2Desc: Click the DressApp icon in your browser toolbar and select "Pair with Mobile App".
extension.step3Desc: Enter the 8-digit PIN above to securely link your wardrobe in real time.
extension.securityNote: Pairing tokens use end-to-end device authorization and expire after 15 minutes of inactivity.
extension.title: Chrome Extension Sync
extension.heroDesc: Instantly capture and import clothing items, measurements, and size charts into your mobile closet while browsing online stores (Zara, ASOS, Mango, Farfetch, etc.).
